text:
Hi, I’m Mina Castellan. I have 5 years of experience in data analysis, data cleaning, dashboards, and admin support, with strong skills in SQL, Excel, Power BI, and Google Sheets.

I’d be glad to support your daily and punctual group tasks for email outreach campaigns. I can help keep lists organized, clean data, and manage repetitive admin work accurately and on time. I’m also comfortable working in Google Docs, email communication, and virtual assistant tasks.

Relevant project: I built Shopify customer segments from order exports for Juniper & Ash Home using Google Sheets and Looker Studio, then fed the segments to the email tool. The top segment represented 9% of customers and 41% of revenue, and email revenue increased by 19%.

I can dedicate 4–5 hours daily, and my wage proposal is $5/hour. How would you like the tasks and priorities organized each day?
